title: Breaking the links: broadband infrastructure and intergenerational income mobility
title_zh: 打破连接：宽带基础设施与代际收入流动性
abstract: Can broadband infrastructure serve as a catalyst for breaking intergenerational income links and promoting social mobility? This paper tries to answer this question by empirically examining the effects of broadband infrastructure on intergenerational income mobility in China. We exploit a quasi-natural experiment provided by the Broadband China Strategy (BCS) and employ a staggered difference-in-differences methodology to draw causal insights, revealing a 0.058 decrease in intergenerational income elasticity in pilot cities compared to non-pilot cities. The effect is particularly pronounced for males, cohorts born in the 1980 s, those whose fathers have rural hukou or lower levels of education, and residents in peri-urban areas surrounding major cities. Mechanism analyses suggest that the increase in intergenerational income mobility is primarily due to reshaping employment opportunities in favour of disadvantaged groups. These findings hold important implications not only for China but also for other developing countries undergoing digitalization.

title: Property tax incidence and housing market in Taiwan
title_zh: 台湾房产税归宿与住房市场
abstract: This research consolidates three views of property tax incidence into a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model and analyzes the effects of property tax shocks on housing markets. We show that the elasticity of substitution between residential housing (owner-occupied) and investment housing (non-owner-occupied) plays an important role for the incidence of the property tax. When applying the model to Taiwan’s housing tax reform, the results indicate that the implementation of a hoarding tax on investment housing fails to curb the investment housing price; the tax effect is passed on to the residential housing price when investment housing and residential housing are considered as complements. A tax on residential housing can effectively moderate residential housing consumption and residential housing prices.

title: Deterring Industrial Vessels from African Coastal Fisheries
title_zh: 阻止工业渔船进入非洲沿海渔业
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Economic Policy · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Can African countries deter industrial fishing vessels from near-shore waters reserved for artisanal fishers? Using radar data released in 2024, this paper provides the first causal evaluation of these Inshore Exclusion Zones (IEZs). Regression discontinuity estimates reveal deterrence in 6 of 20 African countries. Next, we apply bunching estimators to obtain counterfactual vessel distributions uncontaminated by spillovers outside IEZ boundaries. We capture extensive-margin effects by calibrating a discrete choice vessel location model to our bunching estimates. Bioeconomic calculations indicate that IEZs increase artisanal fisher catch by enough to meet key micronutrient requirements for 7 million people.
abstract_zh: 非洲国家能否阻止工业渔船进入为手工渔民保留的近岸水域？本文利用2024年发布的雷达数据，首次对这些近岸禁渔区（IEZs）进行了因果效应评估。断点回归估计结果显示，在20个非洲国家中有6个国家产生了威慑效应。随后，我们应用聚束估计量获取了不受禁渔区边界外溢出效应污染的反事实船舶分布。通过将离散选择船舶定位模型校准至聚束估计结果，我们捕捉了集约边际效应。生物经济核算表明，近岸禁渔区使手工渔民的渔获量增加幅度足以满足700万人的关键微量营养素需求。

title: Another Look at the (Ir)Relevance of Long‐Run Risks for Equity Risk Premia
title_zh: 长期风险对股权风险溢价的（不）相关性再审视
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract: I investigate the empirical asset pricing implications of a three‐factor macro model that extends the baseline consumption model Consumption Capital Asset Pricing Model (CCAPM) by adding the innovations in expected long‐run consumption growth (consumption growth news) and expected long‐run consumption variance (variance news) as risk factors. By using a reasonable cross‐section of equity risk premia, such a model is largely rejected (both on statistical and economic grounds), as the factor risk prices are either insignificant and/or economically implausible, whereas the pricing errors are very large. Thus, long‐run consumption risks (LRR) do not rescue the CCAPM, which represents a major challenge for the voluminous LRR literature.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个三因子宏观模型的实证资产定价含义，该模型在基准消费模型——消费资本资产定价模型（CCAPM）的基础上，将预期长期消费增长（消费增长新闻）和预期长期消费方差（方差新闻）的冲击作为风险因子。通过使用合理的横截面股权风险溢价，该模型在统计和经济层面均被显著拒绝，因为因子风险价格要么不显著，要么在经济上不合理，而定价误差则非常大。因此，长期消费风险（LRR）未能挽救CCAPM，这对大量LRR文献构成了重大挑战。
